verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth Companies page says the firm advises on entity formation, capitalization and equity compensation, and its Executive Compensation page covers stock plans and related tax issues. Capitalization at formation is where founder ownership gets set up, but the materials never address founder equity mechanics specifically. missing for 10: explicit coverage of founder vesting schedules, 83(b) elections, co-founder equity split guidance, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right

citations.quote: We have extensive experience advising our clients on entity formation, capitalization, corporate governance, equity compensation and capital-raising matters
Advising employers and executives on related securities and tax law issues, including Sections 280G and 409A of the Internal Revenue Code.
